item.title: Iran may be activating sleeper cells outside the country, alert says
item.summary: The U.S. has intercepted encrypted communications believed to have originated in Iran that may serve as “an operational trigger” for “sleeper assets."

item.title: Iran live updates: 7th killed service member is identified
item.summary: Two men were in serious condition in central Israel, said Magen David Adom.

item.title: WATCH: War in Iran's impact on gas
item.summary: Oil prices continue to soar, rattling stock markets and threatening price increases for some essential products as war escalated in the Middle East.

item.title: WATCH: Iowa high school basketball player scores 8 points in 19 seconds
item.summary: Trailing in the final minute, Iowa high school sophomore Ava Smid delivered a stunning comeback -- scoring 8 points in just 19 seconds to win the girls state basketball semifinal.

item.title: 'Criminal explosion' strikes synagogue in Belgium, official says
item.summary: The explosion caused "material damage" but there were no casualties and the site, the official said, "has been secured".

item.title: WATCH: Mojtaba Khamenei chosen as Iran's next supreme leader
item.summary: Iran just named a new supreme leader, the late Ayatollah Khamenei's 56-year-old son, Mojtaba Khamenei. President Trump said just days ago that Khamenei's son would be an "unacceptable choice."
